userRequest: Yaklaşık 2 dakikalık, karanlık ve seksi gece atmosferli, modern pop eksenli, vokale alan bırakan enstrümantal bir beat istiyorum. Belirli bir sanatçıyı taklit etmeden referansın çekicilik, doku, enerji ve dramatik pop hissini özgün biçimde yorumla.

creativeBrief: Create a 120-second instrumental dark-pop beat with a seductive late-night atmosphere and a slow, body-moving midtempo pulse. Keep it intimate, shadowed, polished, and hook-forward: tight punchy drums, restrained syncopated percussion, a deep rounded bass foundation, smoky warm synth pads, and one hypnotic synthesized motif as the sonic identity. Use controlled harmonic tension and selective resolution without horror clichés. Leave generous spectral and rhythmic space for a future lead vocal. Build clear contrast through a sparse close-up intro and verse, a rising pre-chorus, a wider and more confident chorus, a stripped bridge, and a concise final chorus/outro. Increase energy through drum weight, width, and texture rather than melodic busyness. Avoid vocals, bright festival EDM, retro pastiche, wall-to-wall synths, overfilled melodies, and constant full-density arrangement.
